subject: Class and category of data items and literals
notes: Rule: '1) An elementary data item described as alphanumeric by its PICTURE character-string.' (cite.py --check 8.5.2.3 OK). PictureAnalyzer.Analyze assigns PicCategory.Alphanumeric (no EditMask, not IsAlphabetic) to a PIC X string; PictureCategoryDriftTests walks every 1..3-symbol picture and asserts each accepted string binds the category its §13.18.40.4 defining GR selects. Probe p2.cob: MOVE 12 TO an X(5) item gives '12   ' (alphanumeric left-justify), as Table 16/§14.9.25.4 require for an alphanumeric receiver. || editions as written by the adjudicator: 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 (no 2014->2023 change in Annex E)
